already_chunked_note: PeerQA ships paper text pre-segmented at the SENTENCE level (papers.jsonl: idx/pidx/sidx/type/content/last_heading). Sentences are ~10-30 tokens (far below a RAG chunk) with NO overlap. We pack consecutive sentences into ~500-token chunks (cap 600) with 100-token overlap; gold sentence idxs map onto parent chunks.
